LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING - THE MATTER WAS CALLED FIRST AT 9:30 A.M., AND THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING. ON THE SECOND CALL OF THE MATTER AT 9:55 A.M., THE DEFENDANTS APOLOGIZED TO THE COURT REGARDING SHOWING UP LATE IN COURT BECAUSE THEY WERE WAITING OUTSIDE THE COURTROOM. THE MATTER WAS ARGUED. THE COURT CONFIRMED ITS EARLIER RULING. DEFENDANTS JOSHUA GRATE AND SHEILA ELLIS'S DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT IS OVERRULED; 5 DAYS TO ANSWER. NOTICE WAS WAIVED BY THE DEFENDANTS.
